skill.name: webask-data-quality
skill.description: Проверяет качество собранных ответов на опрос WebAsk: слишком быстрые прохождения, однообразные ответы, дубли и мусор в текстах. Применяется, когда человек сомневается в данных, подозревает накрутку или готовит результаты к показу.
skill.summary: Review WebAsk survey responses for quality issues and compare results before recommending any exclusions.
skill.author: webaskio

content.value_statement: Suspicious survey responses can distort results and weaken decisions. This skill guides checks of WebAsk responses and compares key metrics before recommending exclusions.
actual_capabilities: Guides response retrieval through get_quiz_answers, get_quiz_report, and get_quiz_report_inputs.
Checks completion speed, repetitive choices, duplicate contacts, meaningless text, contradictory answers, and unusual response bursts.
Reports counts and percentages for each quality indicator.
Estimates how many unique responses remain after proposed exclusions and compares key metrics.
Recommends tagging first, reversible report exclusion next, and deletion only after an explicit request and confirmation.
Preserves legitimate negative ratings and critical comments during quality review.
limitations: Requires access to the three specified WebAsk MCP tools and the relevant survey data.
Uses heuristic indicators, which do not prove fraud or respondent intent.
Provides assistant instructions rather than a standalone validator or tested statistical engine.
Does not independently modify responses and stops when service limits prevent further review.

use_cases.title: Review an incentivized survey
use_cases.description: Inspect fast completions, repeated contacts, and matching response bursts before interpreting results from a rewarded survey.

use_cases.title: Prepare a survey report
use_cases.description: Compare key metrics before and after proposed exclusions to assess whether quality concerns affect the report.

use_cases.title: Investigate conflicting feedback
use_cases.description: Review contradictory responses and possible survey display logic errors without treating negative customer feedback as invalid.

prompt_templates.title: Run a basic quality review
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the response quality for WebAsk survey [survey]. Summarize the main concerns without changing any responses.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: understand whether collected responses need closer review.

prompt_templates.title: Count suspicious response patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [survey] for fast completions, repetitive answers, duplicate contacts, and meaningless text. Report counts and percentages for each indicator.

prompt_templates.title: Measure the impact of exclusions
prompt_templates.prompt: For [survey], compare [key metrics] before and after proposed exclusions. Count overlapping flags only once when calculating remaining responses. Do not modify data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: evaluate whether proposed exclusions change conclusions.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a suspected manipulation pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate matching response bursts, duplicate contacts, and contradictory answers in [survey]. Separate possible display logic errors from suspicious behavior. Compare metric changes and recommend reversible actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine multiple indicators while preserving legitimate feedback.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review 100 responses and estimate the effect of excluding suspicious submissions.
output: Fast completions: 12 responses, or 12%. Repetitive choices: 8 responses, or 8%.
Four responses match both indicators. Unique flagged responses: 16, or 16%.
Excluding those responses would leave 84. The average rating would change from 4.0 to 4.1.
Recommend reviewing and tagging flagged responses before deciding on exclusions. No responses were changed.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review contradictory answers and harsh comments before publishing survey results.
output: Three responses deny using the service but also rate its quality. Review the survey display logic.
Five comments contain specific complaints. Negative sentiment alone is not a reason to exclude them.
Recommend reviewing contradictions separately from critical feedback. No responses were changed.

best_practices: Review suspicious indicators in context before treating any response as invalid.
Report indicator percentages and count overlapping flags only once when estimating remaining responses.
Compare key metrics before exclusions and prefer reversible tagging.
anti_patterns: Removing low ratings or harsh comments solely because they are negative.
Deleting flagged responses without an explicit request and confirmation.
Changing the sample to produce a preferred conclusion.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when the required WebAsk MCP tools are available.

faq.question: What WebAsk tools does it require?
faq.answer: It requires get_quiz_answers, get_quiz_report, and get_quiz_report_inputs to retrieve survey responses, reports, and open-text answers.

faq.question: Does a suspicious response prove fraud?
faq.answer: No. Fast answers, duplicate contacts, or repetitive choices are review indicators. They require context and can have legitimate explanations.

faq.question: Will it automatically delete responses?
faq.answer: No. It recommends actions without applying them independently. Deletion requires an explicit request and confirmation.

faq.question: Does it exclude negative feedback?
faq.answer: No. Low ratings and critical comments are not quality failures by themselves.

faq.question: What happens when a service limit is reached?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to report the limit and stop. It does not recommend an upgrade or direct users to payment.
